Accomplishment
1. Has received 190 patents in the USA and 173 patents in Taiwan

2. From 1996-2003, he was honored with TSMC’s Outstanding Patent and Innovative Invention Awards 8 consecutive times. In 2002 and 2003, he received the TSMC Best Patent Award presented by the Chairman, plus prizes from the government such as Taiwan's National Invention and Creation Award in 2001 and the Executive Yuan Award for Outstanding Talents in Science and Technology in 2003 and the MOEA Award for Industrial Technology Development in 2004.
